senses.gloss:
(I)--issue from the brows of ब्रह्मा.
1: भा. III. १२. २६; M. 3. १०.
शुक्र's homily to देवयानी, when she was angry with शर्मिष्ठा, and her answer.
2: M. २८. 1-१३.
वसिष्ठ on the folly of.
3: Vi. I. 1. १७-19.
(II)--born of Lobha and निकृति. भा. IV. 8. 3.
(I)--a son of Ayuta and father of देवातिथि. भा. IX. २२. ११.
(II)--one of the seven sons of कौशिक. M. २०. 3.
--a गण of कार्दवेय Na1gas inhabiting महातल, afraid only of गरुड. Fought with Rudras in देवासुर battle. भा. V. २४-29; VIII. १०. ३४. [page१-483+ २९]

--a daughter of दक्ष and one of कश्य- pa's wives, and mother of दन्दशूक and other serpents.
1: भा. VI. 6. २६ and २८; वा. ६६. ५४.
Her twelve daughters were married to Pulaha. भूतस्, पिशाचस्, Kinnaras, वानरस् and others belonged to her line.
2: Br. III. 3. ५६; 7. १७१, ४४४ and ४६७; 8. ७२; Vi. I. १५. १२५.
Some of her sons fell a prey to भीमसेन's sword.
3: M. 6. 2 and ४३; १४६. १८.
--a son of Yadu, and father of वृजिनवत्. भा. IX. २३. २० and ३०.
(I)--a son of Yadu and father of द्वजिनीवन्. Br. III. ६९. 2; M. ४३. 7; Vi. IV. ११. 5; १२. 1.
(II)--a son of कार्तवीर्य Arjun3a and राजऋषि; father of वृजिनीवत्. In this line was born वृष्णि. Br. III. ७०. १४-15; M. ४३. ४६; ४४. १४-5. [page१-484+ ४१]
